items.question: 지난주 시간대(0~23시)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH hour_series AS (
  SELECT generate_series(0,23) AS summary_hour
)
SELECT h.summary_hour,
       COALESCE(s.total_sessions,0) AS total_sessions
FROM hour_series h
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT summary_hour, SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY summary_hour
) s ON h.summary_hour = s.summary_hour
ORDER BY h.summary_hour;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
 SELECT traffic_source, sum(sessions) AS sessions_this
 FROM agg_traffic_hourly
 WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
   AND summary_date < current_date + 1
 GROUP BY traffic_source
),
 last_week AS (
 SELECT traffic_source, sum(sessions) AS sessions_last
 FROM agg_traffic_hourly
 WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
   AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
 GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT COALESCE(t.traffic_source, l.traffic_source) AS traffic_source,
       t.sessions_this,
       l.sessions_last,
       COALESCE(t.sessions_this,0) - COALESCE(l.sessions_last,0) AS diff_sessions,
       CASE WHEN l.sessions_last IS NULL OR l.sessions_last=0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (COALESCE(t.sessions_this,0)::numeric / l.sessions_last * 100.0) END AS pct_change
FROM this_week t
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week l USING (traffic_source);

최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 정답 1번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH recent_counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS visits
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7 AND summary_date < current_date
),
prev_counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS visits
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14 AND summary_date < current_date - 7
),
recent_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(visits),2) AS avg_visits
  FROM recent_counts
),
prev_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(visits),2) AS avg_visits
  FROM prev_counts
)
SELECT
  rec.avg_visits AS recent_avg,
  pre.avg_visits AS prev_avg,
  ROUND((rec.avg_visits - pre.avg_visits) / NULLIF(pre.avg_visits,0) * 100.0, 2) AS percent_change
FROM recent_avg rec
CROSS JOIN prev_avg pre;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
 SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS count_this_week
 FROM agg_event_daily
 WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
 GROUP BY event_name
),
 last_week AS (
 SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS count_last_week
 FROM agg_event_daily
 WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
 GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT
 tw.event_name,
 tw.count_this_week,
 lw.count_last_week,
 (tw.count_this_week - lw.count_last_week) AS delta,
 CASE WHEN lw.count_last_week = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (tw.count_this_week - lw.count_last_week)::numeric * 100 / lw.count_last_week
 END AS pct_change
FROM this_week tw
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week lw ON tw.event_name = lw.event_name
ORDER BY delta DESC NULLS LAST;

items.question: 지난주 신규 방문자 수와 재방문자 수는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH first_vis AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(timestamp)::date AS first_date
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp < current_date
  GROUP BY client_id
), last_week_vis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT client_id
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND timestamp < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_vis fv
   WHERE fv.first_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
     AND fv.first_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date) AS new_visitors,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM last_week_vis lw
   JOIN first_vis fv ON lw.client_id = fv.client_id
   WHERE fv.first_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date) AS returning_visitors;

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH last AS (
  SELECT SUM(page_views)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT summary_date),0) AS avg_page_views
  FROM agg_page_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month')
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)
), this AS (
  SELECT SUM(page_views)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT summary_date),0) AS avg_page_views
  FROM agg_page_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
    AND summary_date <= current_date
)
SELECT 
  last.avg_page_views AS last_month_avg,
  this.avg_page_views AS this_month_avg,
  this.avg_page_views - last.avg_page_views AS diff,
  (this.avg_page_views / NULLIF(last.avg_page_views,0)) * 100 AS percent_of_last
FROM last, this;
